notes: Find and pair with a computer on a different reachable private subnet by entering its IPv4 address. Update both computers and generate a pairing code on the other computer before searching.

en: Find and pair with a computer on a different reachable private subnet by entering its IPv4 address. Update both computers and generate a pairing code on the other computer before searching.
zh: 手动输入内网 IPv4 地址，即可查找并配对另一子网内能互访的电脑。请先更新两台电脑，并在对方生成配对码。
es: Busca y vincula un equipo de otra subred privada accesible con su dirección IPv4. Actualiza ambos equipos y genera un código en el otro antes de buscarlo.
